seoTitle: Pig Latin Translator: English to Pig Latin
metaDescription: Turn English into Pig Latin: leading consonants move to the end plus ay, vowel words get way. Keeps capitals and punctuation. Free.
intro: Turn English text into Pig Latin by moving leading consonants to the end and adding "ay", keeping capitals and punctuation.
why:
Pig Latin is a word game that scrambles English so outsiders find it hard to follow. It is also a common exercise for learning string handling.

The common rule is used: a leading group of consonants (with qu kept together) moves to the end and gets ay, and a word that starts with a vowel gets way. You can pick yay, ay or hay as the vowel ending, as variants differ. Capitals and punctuation stay in place.
howTo: Choose the ending for words that start with a vowel.

faq.a: Consonant clusters move with ay, vowel words get way by default. Other variants use yay or hay.
No. Going back is ambiguous because it is not clear where the moved letters began.
